card.name: The editor tag after names in citations
card.fires_on: The word ed, eds or editors (sometimes the period after it) right after a list of personal names in a reference or bibliography entry, marking the people as editors of the cited book.

modes.label: Editor abbreviation after names
modes.description: ed or eds follows a person's name, usually after a comma, just before the book title.
modes.example: Beers MH, Berkow R,<< eds>>. The Merck Manual of Diagnosis and

modes.label: Full word or period
modes.description: The full word editors, or the period after ed, in the same citation slot.
modes.example: A. Z. Broder, and S. Chakrabarti,<< editors>>, pp. 183-

card.plain: It spots the point in a reference list where the authors are labeled as the book's editors.
